name: autocode
description: Autonomous multi-agent coding framework powered by Claude AI
author: Autocode Team

scripts.start: npm run build:core && cd apps/desktop && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && cd apps/desktop && npm run dev
scripts.dev:debug: npm run build:core && cd apps/desktop && npm run dev:debug
scripts.dev:mcp: npm run build:core && cd apps/desktop && npm run dev:mcp
scripts.dev:web: npm --workspace @autocode/core run ensure-built && npm --workspace autocode-web run dev
scripts.dev:web:service: npm --workspace @autocode/core run ensure-built && npm --workspace autocode-web run dev:service
scripts.dev:vscode: npm run build:core && npm --workspace autocode-vscode run watch
scripts.dev:cli: npm run build:core && npm --workspace autocode-cli run dev --
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace @autocode/core run ensure-built && npm --workspace autocode-web run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build:vscode && cd apps/desktop && npm run build
scripts.typecheck:web: npm --workspace @autocode/core run ensure-built && npm --workspace autocode-web run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:cli && npm run typecheck:vscode && cd apps/desktop && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run build:core && cd apps/desktop && npm run build
